registry_contract.dependencies: G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-54 and the strict Forest/Fourfold verified cross-plane authority contract

migration_and_rollback.projection_note: This packet is closed-research with production_change false. Removing it rolls back only the research record; no production, branch-topology, archive or historical evidence mutation is involved.

title: Bind multi-relation cross-plane rows to verified Fourfold authority before production change

masterplan.gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

issue_scope.priority: align the canonical multi-relation compiler with the already-declared verified cross-plane trust boundary without adding a second compiler, verifier, graph schema or relation authority
issue_scope.bounded_scope: cross-plane ForestEdge admission in compile_relation_blocks only; same-plane retained-relation semantics, scalar observers, Tensor execution and legacy adapter directionality remain otherwise unchanged

finding.contract_boundary: The Fourfold/Tensor reference contract states that cross-plane rows come only from verified FourfoldSnapshot.bindings. CrossPlaneBinding is explicitly the verified semantic relation type between different planes, while FourfoldSnapshot retains only independently verified cross-plane bindings.
finding.implementation_drift: compile_relation_blocks currently constructs a RelationSignature for every ForestEdge and appends every directed edge, including cross-plane edges, to edge_records and discovered. The later fact loop can therefore materialize a cross-plane row directly from ForestEdge independently of FourfoldSnapshot.bindings. A focused regression also currently expects include_verified_bindings=False to retain one semantic cross-plane fact from the raw Forest edge. That behavior broadens the declared Fourfold trust boundary.
finding.risk: A directed cross-plane ForestEdge that was not upgraded to a verified CrossPlaneBinding can become an apparently authoritative TypedRelationBlock coordinate. Sparse relation blocks carry no proposal/unverified state, so this is a trust-level collapse rather than a harmless duplicate representation.
finding.important_non_fix: Simply ignoring all raw cross-plane Forest edges could turn an observed-but-unverified relation into a silent sparse zero. The next implementation must preserve fail-closed uncertainty rather than replace trust inflation with lossy omission.

decision.summary: Freeze further cross-plane relation-compiler expansion and repair this in the existing compile_relation_blocks owner next. A directed cross-plane ForestEdge may act only as a refusal/consistency signal; an admitted cross-plane row must come from an exact verified Fourfold binding. If a selected or discover-all cross-plane Forest relation lacks a matching verified binding, compilation should fail closed before Forest evidence materialization. When an exact verified binding exists, the raw Forest edge must not become a second provenance/fact source; the binding alone materializes the row. Explicitly unrelated selections may continue to prune the raw cross-plane edge. GPU-52 undirected refusal and GPU-54 adapter directionality remain authoritative.
decision.gardener_note: This closed research packet prevents a parallel cross-plane verifier or second relation schema. The bounded implementation target is an in-owner authority check plus focused regressions, not another abstraction.

focused_next_contracts: a selected or discover-all directed cross-plane ForestEdge without an exact verified Fourfold binding fails closed before _forest_edge_atoms or _record_fact can materialize it
a directed cross-plane ForestEdge with an exact verified binding contributes no independent row or provenance bundle; the verified CrossPlaneBinding is the sole cross-plane fact source
include_verified_bindings=False never downgrades a raw cross-plane ForestEdge into an authoritative row; a conflicting observed cross-plane relation remains fail-closed rather than silently trusted
an explicitly unrelated selected relation may prune a raw cross-plane ForestEdge without materializing its evidence or blocking an independent same-plane relation
existing same-plane retained-digest admission, endpoint completeness, hyperedge refusal, GPU-52 undirected refusal, GPU-54 adapter directionality and scalar observer contracts remain unchanged

verification.notes: Closed research packet only. Exact source/blob evidence demonstrates the contract/implementation/test drift; no production behavior is claimed fixed and no full-suite or benchmark claim is made.

claims.correctness: verified cross-plane authority drift identified and the smallest fail-closed in-owner repair scoped; production gap is not yet claimed fixed
